map.人血与动物血的种属鉴别: Species Differentiation Between Human and Animal Blood
map.标准流程：①预试验（联苯胺/酚酞等，灵敏度高但非特异性）；②确证试验（血色原结晶: Standard workflow: 1 screening test (benzidine or phenolphthalein, high sensitivity but not specific); 2 confirmatory test (haemochromogen crystal test, absorption spectrophotometry); 3 species identification (anti-human haemoglobin precipitin, agar diffusion); 4 ABO typing (neutralisation test or enzyme-linked assay). Interpret the positive and negative combinations of each step.
map.预试验联苯胺阳性 → 确证血色原结晶阳性 → 抗人血红蛋白沉淀素阳性（为人血）→: A positive benzidine screening test → positive haemochromogen crystal test → positive anti-human haemoglobin precipitin (human blood) → the ABO neutralisation test shows the A antigen neutralised, so it is typed as a group A bloodstain. Four stepwise confirmations avoid misreading plant peroxidase false positives as human blood.
map.预试验阳性就能认定血吗？: Does a positive screening test prove blood?
map.不能。预试验灵敏度高但易受植物汁液、金属等过氧化物酶干扰出现假阳性，必须经确证试: No. Screening tests are highly sensitive but easily give false positives from plant juices and metals that act as peroxidase, so a confirmatory test and species identification are required.
map.陈旧血痕测不出血型怎么办？: What if typing fails on an old bloodstain?
map.血型物质可随时间降解，陈旧或微量血痕常测不出；可改测 DNA 分型（STR）作为: Blood group substances degrade over time, so old or minute stains often cannot be typed. DNA profiling (STR) can be used instead for individual identification.
